notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= on_hour) & (hour_of_day() < off_hour), base_temp + outdoor_slope * T_out + boost_delta, base_temp + outdoor_slope * T_out - setback_delta)
notebook.mechanism: occupied-period warm-up boost with unoccupied setback layered on outdoor-reset supply temperature
notebook.targets: positive residual around morning and evening, negative residual around midday; hourly shape not captured by plain outdoor reset
notebook.refute: if the fitted occupied window collapses or is implausible, or if held-out error does not improve over the current best schedule and the hourly residual remains two-peaked
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(hysteresis(T_out, lo_temp, hi_temp), base_temp + outdoor_slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: outdoor warm-weather shutdown with hysteresis, a common boiler interlock that disables heating above an outdoor cutoff
notebook.targets: strong negative residual at high outdoor bands and shoulder-month residual; heat-on share near zero
notebook.refute: if the fitted cutoff lies outside plausible weather-compensation range, or if high-outdoor residual and heat-on share are not reduced
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((month() >= start_month) & (month() <= end_month), base_temp + outdoor_slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: calendar-based heating-season changeover, as used by simple controllers that only enable heating during part of the year
notebook.targets: monthly residual pattern with negative shoulder months and positive adjacent months
notebook.refute: if the fitted season excludes the shoulder months or if monthly residual remains after fitting
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= on_hour) & (hour_of_day() < off_hour), base_temp + loop_gain * (setpoint - T_room), base_temp - setback_delta)
notebook.mechanism: occupied-period proportional room thermostat with unoccupied setback, rather than open-loop weather compensation
notebook.targets: residual not explained by pure outdoor reset; room-temperature feedback and occupied/unoccupied schedule
notebook.refute: if fitted loop gain is near zero, or if held-out error is worse than schedule-only and room-temperature residual is not reduced
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(((hour_of_day() >= on_a) & (hour_of_day() < off_a)) | ((hour_of_day() >= on_b) & (hour_of_day() < off_b)), level + slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: programmable thermostat with two daily comfort periods, morning and evening, and no heat between them
notebook.targets: the positive morning and evening residual humps with a negative midday dip in the diurnal residual pattern
notebook.refute: fitted comfort blocks collapse to one block or overlap, or held-out error does not improve over the single-block schedule
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(((hour_of_day() >= on_a) & (hour_of_day() < off_a)) | ((hour_of_day() >= on_b) & (hour_of_day() < off_b)), level + boost, level - boost)
notebook.mechanism: two daily occupancy blocks sharing one boost and one setback level, without outdoor reset
notebook.targets: the same morning and evening residual humps but with a common boost above and setback below a baseline
notebook.refute: fitted boost is near zero, or the schedule does not beat the single-block outdoor-reset schedule
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(T_out < cutoff, level + slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: outdoor thermostat lockout that shuts heating off above a warm outdoor cutoff
notebook.targets: the strong negative residual at the warmest outdoor band, where the linear outdoor-reset curve overpredicts heat
notebook.refute: fitted cutoff lies outside the observed outdoor range, or the lockout does not improve over the plain outdoor-reset curve
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(weekday() >= weekend_start, where((hour_of_day() >= we_on) & (hour_of_day() < we_off), level, OFF), where((hour_of_day() >= wk_on) & (hour_of_day() < wk_off), level, OFF))
notebook.mechanism: separate weekday and weekend occupancy schedules with different on and off times
notebook.targets: the weekday-to-weekend residual offset and the different weekday residual pattern
notebook.refute: fitted weekend_start does not separate weekend from weekday, or the separate schedules do not improve held-out error
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)
stop: 2 rounds without a program improving the held-out score by more than the noise band

notebook.expr: OFF

notebook.mechanism: Weather curve, linear

notebook.mechanism: On/off thermostat with hysteresis

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= n_on) | (hour_of_day() < n_off), level - drop + slope * T_out, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: Weather curve plus night setback

notebook.expr: clip(level + slope * T_out, lo, hi)
notebook.mechanism: Weather curve with min/max clamps

notebook.expr: T_room + kp * (sp - T_room) + integral(sp - T_room, ti)
notebook.mechanism: PI control on room temperature

notebook.expr: level + slope * T_out + kp * (sp - T_room)
notebook.mechanism: Weather curve plus proportional room feedback

notebook.expr: where(hysteresis(T_room, lo, hi), level + slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: Room thermostat with hysteresis enables weather-compensated supply only when the room falls below the lower threshold and disables it above the upper threshold.
notebook.targets: hourly residual shape and outdoor-band error
notebook.refute: If the fitted hysteresis band collapses, or held-out error is no better than plain weather compensation or a constant-level room thermostat, or the hourly residual pattern remains.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= on_hour) & (hour_of_day() < off_hour), level + slope * T_out + boost, level + slope * T_out - setback)
notebook.mechanism: Occupancy schedule raises the weather-compensated supply during an active window and applies a setback outside it, producing a daily boost and night setback.
notebook.targets: evening positive residual and early-morning negative residual
notebook.refute: If the fitted active window does not align with the positive residual hours, or boost and setback fit near zero, or held-out error does not improve over a simple schedule drop.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(hysteresis(T_out, lo, hi), level + slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: Outdoor-reset heating curve with a warm-weather lockout and hysteresis, so heating is enabled only after outdoor temperature falls below the lower threshold and disabled after it rises above the upper threshold.
notebook.targets: warm outdoor-band negative residual
notebook.refute: If the fitted lockout thresholds sit outside the warm residual band, or held-out error is no better than plain weather compensation, or the warm-band residual is unchanged.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((month() >= start_month) & (month() <= end_month), level + slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: Calendar-based heating-season enable gates the weather-compensated supply, allowing heating only within a configured season.
notebook.targets: monthly residual pattern
notebook.refute: If the fitted season covers all months, or held-out error does not improve, or the monthly residual pattern remains after gating.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(T_out > cutoff, OFF, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: warm-weather shutdown: the boiler is disabled above an outdoor cutoff, so no reset-curve supply is requested
notebook.targets: large negative residual in the warm outdoor band
notebook.refute: If held-out error does not improve over plain outdoor reset, or the fitted cutoff is not in the mild/warm range, warm-weather shutdown is not supported.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= dhw_start) & (hour_of_day() < dhw_end), level + slope * T_out + dhw_boost, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: domestic hot water priority or an evening occupancy boost raises the boiler supply setpoint for a scheduled evening window
notebook.targets: positive late-evening residual
notebook.refute: If the fitted window is not evening or the boost does not reduce held-out error, the evening residual is not a scheduled DHW or occupancy boost.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(T_out < knee, level + slope_cold * T_out, level + slope_mild * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: piecewise outdoor reset curve with a knee, common in weather-compensated controllers to change slope at mild outdoor temperatures
notebook.targets: outdoor-band curvature: mild-band residual differs from cold and warm bands
notebook.refute: If a single slope fits as well or the fitted knee is at an implausible outdoor temperature, the reset curve is not piecewise.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= setback_start) & (hour_of_day() < setback_end), level + slope * T_out - setback, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: unoccupied afternoon setback lowers the supply setpoint during a scheduled low-occupancy window
notebook.targets: negative midday and afternoon residual
notebook.refute: If the fitted window is not midday/afternoon or the setback does not reduce held-out error, the residual is not an occupancy setback.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)
stop: 2 rounds without a program improving the held-out score by more than the noise band

notebook.expr: where(hysteresis(T_out, lo, hi), level + slope * T_out, OFF)
notebook.mechanism: outdoor-temperature changeover thermostat enables the heating curve only when outdoor air is cold enough, with hysteresis to avoid chattering at the cutoff
notebook.targets: outdoor-band residuals: heating persists in cold bands and shuts off in warm bands, with hysteresis at the changeover
notebook.refute: if the fitted cutoff is outside a plausible outdoor range or held-out warm-band residual does not improve, changeover is not the missing mechanism
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(((hour_of_day() >= h_morning) & (hour_of_day() < h_midday)) | (hour_of_day() >= h_evening), level + slope * T_out + boost, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: programmable thermostat with dual occupied periods raises the supply curve during morning and evening occupancy and falls back to the weather-compensated curve otherwise
notebook.targets: hourly residual: positive morning and evening periods in both rooms, with midday and late-night deficits
notebook.refute: if the fitted occupied windows do not align with the residual peaks or held-out hourly residual does not improve, dual occupancy is not the missing mechanism
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((weekday() >= d_start) & (weekday() <= d_end), level + slope * T_out + boost, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: weekday-dependent setpoint or occupancy schedule applies a different heating curve on selected weekdays
notebook.targets: weekday residual: midweek positive bias in both rooms, especially the television room
notebook.refute: if the fitted weekday window does not match the residual weekday pattern or held-out weekday residual does not improve, weekday scheduling is not the missing mechanism
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((month() >= m_start) & (month() <= m_end), level + slope * T_out + boost, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: seasonal changeover or shoulder-season setpoint offset modifies the heating curve for a contiguous part of the year
notebook.targets: monthly residual: opposite-sign shoulder-season biases in the fireplace room and positive spring bias in the television room
notebook.refute: if the fitted month window does not match the residual month pattern or held-out monthly residual does not improve, seasonal offset is not the missing mechanism
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= h_start) & (hour_of_day() < h_end) & (T_out < cold_cut), level + slope * T_out + boost, level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: Optimum-start morning warm-up: controller raises supply temperature during an early clock window only when outdoor is cold, then returns to the weather-compensated curve.
notebook.targets: fireplace morning positive residual and cold outdoor band
notebook.refute: If fitted boost is negligible, the clock window collapses, or held-out morning residual does not fall relative to weather compensation alone.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where((hour_of_day() >= h_occ_start) & (hour_of_day() < h_occ_end), level + slope * T_out + kp * (sp - T_room), level + slope * T_out)
notebook.mechanism: Occupancy-scheduled room feedback: closed-loop room-temperature correction only during occupied hours; open-loop weather compensation otherwise.
notebook.targets: midday negative residual and hour-of-day shape in both rooms
notebook.refute: If kp fits near zero, the occupancy window is implausible, or the midday and evening residual pattern remains.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: level + slope * lag(T_out, tau) + kp * (sp - T_room)
notebook.mechanism: Weather compensation using lagged outdoor temperature plus room feedback, representing slab or building thermal lag in the reset curve.
notebook.targets: outdoor-band and month residual drift, slow thermal mass
notebook.refute: If tau sits at a bound, kp is negligible, or held-out error is not better than plain outdoor reset with room feedback.
notebook.verdict: refuted (worse than best by more than the noise band)

notebook.expr: where(lag(T_out, tau) < cutoff, clip(level + slope * T_out, lo, hi), OFF)
notebook.mechanism: Warm-weather shutdown with lagged outdoor sensing and supply-temperature min/max limits, so the boiler is off above a cutoff and supply is clipped at extremes.

notebook.refute: If cutoff is not selected, clip bounds are inactive, or held-out warm-band residual does not improve over simple outdoor reset.
